# CG-REQ-027: Request pattern changed

A request string pattern was replaced by a different one.

**Why it matters:** Regex inclusion is undecidable in general for ECMA-262 patterns.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.patternChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Pattern of {where} changed from `{from}` to `{to}`.
>
> ContractGuard does not decide whether one regular expression accepts everything the other accepts.
>
> **Fix:** Review whether every value matching `{from}` also matches `{to}`.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: pattern edited

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^[a-z]+$'}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^[a-z0-9]+$'}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, medium. Pattern of POST /x: the request body (application/json) changed from `^[a-z]+$` to `^[a-z0-9]+$`.

### Does not fire: identical pattern

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
        requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^a'}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Regex language inclusion is not decided in v1.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-027
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-027: { severity: low }
```
